name: Littmann Classic II Pediatric Stethoscope, Caribbean Blue
seoTitle: Littmann Pediatric Stethoscope for Peds Nurses
metaDescription: The Littmann Classic II Pediatric stethoscope with a stainless chestpiece and Caribbean blue tube. A cheerful, practical gift for pediatric nurses.
summary: A Classic II Pediatric stethoscope in bright Caribbean blue, a practical and cheerful gift for nurses who care for kids.
whyItWorks: Pediatric nurses spend their shifts helping kids feel less scared, and bright colors help. A Caribbean blue tube reads as friendly instead of clinical, which can make a small patient a little more curious and a little less nervous. A pediatric stethoscope is sized with children in mind, so it is a gift that reflects the specific work they do rather than a one size fits all present.

The Classic II Pediatric has a stainless steel chestpiece, according to the title, and the tube is listed at 28 inches. That makes it a nice option for pediatric floor nurses, school nurses, and clinic nurses who see children all day. It works as a welcome gift for someone starting a peds job or as a thank you from a family whose child was cared for in the hospital. Nurses often use whatever their unit has on hand, so a dedicated pediatric stethoscope of their own can feel like a real upgrade.
goodToKnow: Pediatric models are sized for children, so confirm the recipient works mainly with kids.
Compare with the rainbow finish 2153 version if you want a more colorful chestpiece.
A fun character stethoscope tag or badge reel makes a good add on for peds nurses.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a school nurse?
faq.a: Yes. School nurses see children all day, so a pediatric stethoscope suits their work well.

faq.q: What is the difference between this and the 2153?
faq.a: Both are Classic II Pediatric models with a Caribbean blue tube. The 2119 has a standard stainless steel chestpiece, while the 2153 has a rainbow finish chestpiece and brass stem and headset.
